linkedin:
A QRON code doesn't have to look like a QR code. Generate one in Holographic mode, Memory mode, or plain — swap the art style and the artwork changes completely. What doesn't change is what's underneath: every design, however stylized, is still Ed25519-signed and anchored under the AuthiChain protocol.

That's a deliberate split. The visual style is a decorative layer — pick whatever fits the product, the invitation, the packaging. The signature is a separate, structural layer that a style choice can't touch: a Holographic-mode code and a plain one carry the same kind of cryptographic backing, just wrapped differently.

We built it this way because most 'designer QR code' tools trade scannability, or any real verification, for looks: heavy stylization can break the scan itself, or the code ends up being just an image with a link baked in, nothing to check. QRON keeps decoration and signing on separate tracks so neither one has to give ground to the other.

If you've been choosing between a QR code that looks good and one that can actually be checked, that shouldn't be the tradeoff.

reddit.title: We separated "looks good" from "can be verified" in our QR code generator — curious what design folks think
reddit.body:
QRON generates QR codes as actual artwork — Holographic mode, Memory mode, a few others — instead of the standard black-and-white grid, while keeping the code scannable. Separately, every generated design is Ed25519-signed and anchored under the AuthiChain protocol, regardless of which style rendered it.

The reasoning: most "designer QR code" generators either break scannability once they stylize enough to look good, or they look fine but are just an image with a link baked in — no signature, nothing to check. We wanted style and verification to sit on separate layers, so picking a heavier style doesn't cost you anything on the verification side.

Would like feedback from this crowd specifically: does the Holographic/Memory framing read as a style choice worth having, or does "here's a signed QR code that also looks nice" undersell what's actually different about it?

https://qron.space/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=qron-style-modes&utm_content=a

Disclosure: I work on this project.
